findings.body: The Done-when requirement is only partially met. `docs/review-instructions.md:25–26` now states that end-to-end tests run nightly, not at close or in PR CI, but `apps/core/AGENTS.md` contains no equivalent statement. Add that rule to this section so both named documents express all three promised policies.
